Subject: Proposal: Co-hosted Developer Lab series (ScaleNet x Redwood)

Hi Neha (and Marissa),

Hope you9re well. ScaleNet is running a small partner-led "Developer Lab" initiative next quarter and we9d love to co-host a three-part technical lab series with Redwood. The series is aimed at platform engineers and infra teams: short (30-45min) deep dives with a hands-on demo + Q&A. Our hypothesis is that joint labs are the fastest way to generate qualified product-led pipeline -- less slide decks, more sandbox-led conversions.

High-level asks from our side:
- Redwood to provide a host speaker (engineer) + a short demo sandbox (1 GPU test workspace)
- Joint promotion: blog swap, two promo emails, and one social carousel post each
- Lead capture via a shared HubSpot form (we can provide the form)

I attached a one-pager with target audience and suggested topics. Proposed timing: late Sept -> Oct cadence (one every two weeks).

If this sounds interesting, can we set a quick 30-min sync to align on audience, KPIs, and ops? Tom (cc9d) is our partnerships lead and will help coordinate.

Thanks,
Elena
Partnerships, ScaleNet

- Audience: primarily mid-market platform and infra engineering managers; a small number of enterprise prospects (30% estimated).
- Concurrency: planning for up to 120 registrants, with ~40 doing hands-on (we can stagger sandbox access).
- Reporting cadence: event-level consolidated report (registrations, attendance, MQLs) within 48 hours; weekly recap only if follow-up nurture runs.

Attached: devlab-draft-agenda.xlsx (3 session outlines + proposed speakers). We9d like Redwood to lead session 2 ("Low-latency inference at scale: Practical tips & demo") and to host a short live sandbox demo.

Operational asks:
1) Can Redwood provision a short-term sandbox with a single GPU and anonymized sample data?
2) Can we use a joint HubSpot form (we will share) and do a shared email to mutual lists?

If that all works, we9ll move to slot dates: 9/30, 10/14, 10/28 (all 11:00 AM PT).

Appreciate it,
Elena
